family: The single total certificate-prefix language defined by the exact evaluator in proof.md Part A: at actual length N choose the least prime k>=B, where B is the least positive integer with B^5>32*N^3; test the k-bit monic-polynomial prefix by the prime-degree irreducibility test; on a valid prefix apply the specified descending-power BK symmetric polynomial and constant-coefficient functional to the zero-padded N-k payload. The specified small-length and invalid-prefix branches return zero. One fixed polynomial-time evaluator and empty-witness NP verifier define all lengths.
theorem: For this one fixed total language in P, hence NP, every exact full-B2 circuit at actual input length N has at least 4N-52*N^(4/5) gates for every integer N>=2^20. In particular liminf over all integer N of C_B2(F_N)/N>=4, with the all-length epsilon thresholds proved in proof.md Part D.
